messages.content: I want to put ₹5 lakh in a Kaveri Bank fixed deposit for 2 years. What rate would I get, and how much will I have when it matures?

graders.description: The maturity amount at Kaveri Bank's 2-year rate, 6.95% (general public), compounded quarterly.

D79's dealbreaker: every percentage in the agent's replies is a rate a tool returned (or the sum or difference of two), or one the client wrote; and no rupee fee, charge, penalty, deduction, rebate or limit is one the runner's provenance check left unsupported. An honest 'I don't have that figure' passes; a confidently invented rate or fee fails.

The judge (rubric advice.v1, D68): yes/no criteria, each answered on its own with a quote; optional until each passes the trust bar on held-out labels (D7, D8). Its severity is the most severe of its criteria's.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.
Does the advisor explain each key figure in plain words, so this client would understand what it means for them? Yes or no.
